Quick Create

R100

A quick and fun painting activity where you choose 3 figures from 19 available options and 4 paint colours.

How it works:
WhatsApp me and I'll send you the 19 figure options. You choose your 3 figures, tell me your 4 colours, and I'll send you the payment details.

Art Pack

R280

A complete little painting pack with a template you can choose from one of our available categories, plus 4 paint colours.

How it works:
WhatsApp me and tell me that you want an Art Pack. I'll ask which category you would like, then I'll send you the available templates from that category. You choose your template and 4 colours, and I'll send you the payment details.

Template categories include:

Cartoon • Animals • Dogs • Cats • Fantasy • Cars • Safari • Clothes • Holidays • Birds
